expectations.text: reads the Work (work show) before any mutation
expectations.evidence: Section 1 ('Re-establish ground truth before any side effect (read-only)') runs `team-run work show --work-id "$HARNESS_WORK_ID" --json` first, before any of the mutating start/submit commands in sections 3-6.

`member work start --work-id ... --expected-version <version-from-step-1>` (section 3) and `member work submit --work-id ... --expected-version <latest-version-after-step-3> ...` (section 6) both carry --expected-version; no other mutating command is issued (w-12 is explicitly not claimed/started).

expectations.text: names the provider-completed trap: runtime 'completed' is not Work done; verifies prior edits then submits
expectations.evidence: 'Trap 1 — "Provider completed" is not "Work done"' quotes the skill directly: 'Provider "completed" is not Work "done." Submission moves Work to review; only explicit Host acceptance moves it to done.' Section 2 recovers prior edits via `git status/diff/log`, section 4 re-verifies with repeated test runs, and only then section 6 submits.

expectations.text: refuses peer assignment-by-message for W-12; board claim is the only path and only if open/eligible
expectations.evidence: Section 5: 'I do **not** run `member work claim` or `member work start` on w-12 from this message alone... If W-12 genuinely needs a new owner, that requires an explicit Work operation — either I `member work claim` it *after* w-9 is out of `active`, or the Host reassigns/rebinds it, or rex releases it back to `team_claim`.' Also checks `work show --work-id w-12` first rather than trusting rex's claim.

expectations.text: submission carries result summary plus artifact/check refs
expectations.evidence: Section 6 submit command includes `--result-summary "## RESULT ... ## SUMMARY ... ## COVERAGE ..."`, `--artifact-ref <PR-URL>`, and `--check-ref "<test command run 30x>: 0 failures"`.
